cs.label: d.

cs.label: e.
cs.content: Rybaření -- rybník jako součást agroturistického zařízení, povolenky, revíry, vlastní produkce ryb pro hosty, sportovní a rekreační rybolov

cs.label: f.

cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: -Rozvinout znalosti z předmětu Agroturistika, získání informací o možnostech rozvoje agroturistiky a nabídky služeb na českém venkově a prakticky se s tímto seznámit. Studenti získají znalosti o možnostech zviditelnění regionů, podpoře a využití atraktivit cestovního ruchu, které budou moci využít při vlastním podnikání v této oblasti nebo např. při práci v obecním zastupitelstvu.

en.label: a.

en.label: b.
en.content: Traditions in the rural areas and their utilization in the rural tourism - traditional craft, open-air museums, celebrations, craft fairs, legislation, organization

en.label: c.

en.label: a.

en.label: b.

en.label: c.

en.label: d.
en.content: Horse tourism - marking of horse trails, safety of travelling with horses, horse stations, horse trails

en.label: e.
en.content: Hunting tourism - forest as a part of agritouristic farm, legislation, game management

en.label: f.
en.content: Agritourism in protected landscape areas - Protected landscape areas, National parks, eco-tourism, guided tours, birdwatching

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: -To develop knowledge of subject Agritourism. Subject praktically informs students about possibilities of agritouristic development in Czech countryside, about services, utilization of attractiveness of tourism, which they can use in their own business or for example in their work in a local council.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Man and the countryside - traditions (allowance 6/4) a.A man and the countryside - changes in the landscape, history of tourism and agritourismb.Traditions in the rural areas and their utilization in the rural tourism - traditional craft, open-air museums, celebrations, craft fairs, legislation, organizationc.Folklore and folklore celebretions as a part of rural tourism - costumes, folklore areas, folklore celebrations2.Special agritourism (allowance 18/8) a.Wine-growing and agritourism - wine trails, wine-growing regions, production, categories, wine tasting, vintage, legislationb.Utilization of zootherapy in agritourism - categories of zootherapy, hiporehabilitation, canistherapy, other kinds of zootherapyc.Forms of relaxation in agritourism - fitness, wellness, the first aid, hiking, cycling, water sports - canoeing, history, Association of Czech tourists, maps, marking of trails, services for guests, insuranced.Horse tourism - marking of horse trails, safety of travelling with horses, horse stations, horse trailse.Hunting tourism - forest as a part of agritouristic farm, legislation, game managementf.Agritourism in protected landscape areas - Protected landscape areas, National parks, eco-tourism, guided tours, birdwatching
